summary.headline: Index of Apomasar’s Third Book
summary.text: Chapters 218–221 of the second book of Apomasar’s apotelesmatic mysteries concern travel, prisoners, inquiries about absent persons, and rumor. The index of the third book of Apomasar’s Introduction then begins with chapters on celestial influence, the Moon’s 28 places, astrological timing, childbirth, sheep, the spherical heavens, fixed stars and planets, signs, the Sun and Moon, the seven planets, and terms.
